summary: Backend-only testing of Geoapify Route Planner integration. All 21 tests passed covering the full flow: available items, route creation, stop assignment, Geoapify optimization, persistence and priorities.

minor.issue: Response is wrapped as {available_items: [...]} not a raw list. Minor inconsistency vs other list endpoints, but functional.

critical_code_review_comments: stop_id generation uses uuid.uuid4().int[:7] which could theoretically collide; consider using uuid4().hex[:8] for safer uniqueness
POST /api/routes does not accept budget_item_ids directly; stops must be added via PUT /api/routes/{id}/stops in a separate step - correct flow but frontend must implement it in two steps
seed_data_creation: Used existing seed data: 3 budget items (ITM-2652798, ITM-2090301, ITM-*). Routes created and deleted during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend Geoapify endpoints working. Flow: (1) GET /api/budget-items/available-for-routes returns {available_items:[...]}; (2) POST /api/routes with {vehicle_type, planned_date, planned_start_time, alias}; (3) PUT /api/routes/{id}/stops with [{budget_item_id, priority}]; (4) POST /api/routes/{id}/optimize-geoapify returns {total_stops, total_distance_km, total_duration_minutes, geoapify_status}. Stop IDs are unique (UUID-based). Priorities work correctly (order_sequence 1..N). Agenda fields present in stops.
